player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngi jigeen {player_id} ci SimpleTak.
Ci bortu bi, simo yi ngi àppar ci '{player_stone}' ak simo sa jigeen la wàkk ci '{opponent_stone}'.

Ci wàkk gi, tàggal ak sel bu bëgg ciy nimero (ciy indexam), jox simo ci.
Waxtaan, '[12]' joxe simo ci sel 12.

Wàkk gi moo taxaw, doxal simo yi ci bortu bi, saxal na dëkk-dëkk (bëj-sa-bëj walla sedd-sa-sedd).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nimero sel ku daba {cell_num}. Waa kàggoo 0 ak {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cell {cell_num} is already occupied. Choose an empty cell.

outcome.winner: Jigeen {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') jëkkële na sax na dëkk-dëkk.
outcome.draw: Bànk bi fees na, te benn la!
